seo.title: Carpentry Services in Vancouver | VV Renovation
seo.description: Carpentry for renovation projects in Greater Vancouver. Decks, timber walkways, stairs, railings, wood repairs and interior trim. Request a free estimate.

hero.title: Carpentry Services
hero.subtitle: Decks, walkways, stairs and wood details, built with care for your home or commercial space.

intro.title: Woodwork for Commercial and Residential spaces
intro.mainText: From a timber walkway to the finishing details inside a room, good carpentry brings a space together. VV Renovation installs and repairs decks, stairs, railings and interior wood details for residential and commercial renovation projects.
intro.secondaryText: Based in Richmond and serving Greater Vancouver, we work with you to plan the layout, choose materials and fit each detail to the space.

mediaItems.alt: Carpenter cutting a timber board with a mitre saw during on-site woodwork

cards.title: Decks & Walkways
cards.text: Installation and replacement of decking and timber walkways, fitted to the building and the surrounding site.

cards.title: Stairs & Railings
cards.text: Wooden steps, handrails and railing details for entrances, decks and outdoor connections.

cards.title: Wood Repairs
cards.text: Repair and replacement of worn or damaged wood as part of a renovation, with the scope assessed on site.

cards.title: Interior Trim
cards.text: Baseboards, door and window trim, and other finishing details with careful cuts and neat joints.

cards.title: Custom Wood Details
cards.text: Wood features and fitted details planned around your layout, materials and renovation goals.

cards.title: Renovation Carpentry
cards.text: Practical woodwork coordinated with the other trades, from preparation through to the finishing stage.

steps.title: Discuss the Work
steps.text: Send us a few photos and tell us what you would like to build, repair or replace.

steps.title: Measure & Plan
steps.text: We assess the space, confirm the materials and details, and prepare a project-specific estimate.

steps.title: Build & Install
steps.text: We complete the agreed woodwork with attention to fit, alignment and the surrounding finishes.

steps.title: Review Together
steps.text: We walk through the work with you, check the details and leave the area ready to use or for the next trade.

items.question: What carpentry work do you offer?
items.answer: Our work includes decks, timber walkways, stairs, railings, wood repairs and interior trim. Send us photos or drawings so we can confirm the scope for your project.

items.question: Can you repair existing woodwork?
items.answer: Yes. We assess the condition on site and discuss which parts can be repaired and which may need replacement before agreeing on the work.

items.question: Do you work on residential and commercial projects?
items.answer: Yes. We provide carpentry for homes and commercial renovation projects across Greater Vancouver. Projects outside this area can be discussed individually.

items.question: How do I get an estimate?
items.answer: Use the form below or call us with a description of the work. Photos, approximate dimensions and your preferred timing help us prepare for the consultation.
